name: Hide disabled pick quota cards
description: Render only progress cards for pick categories with a positive configured limit. Commit and verify independently.
result: Pick quota progress cards now render only when that pick category has a positive configured limit.

name: Stabilize league pick scoring and league experience
description: Investigate and fix reported production issues using production-data.db: completed games are not updated/scored; duplicate picks must be prevented for the same game/week/year/league; league renames must preserve picks; league-group membership/settings behavior must be correct. Then deliver independently committed UI/product enhancements: game detail visual consistency, selected-league persistence, and clear weekly closing-over-under/spread presentation. Preserve unrelated existing workspace changes. Verify each fix against code and production data where applicable.
result: Completed all four production bug fixes, three requested UX enhancements, and a scheduler-write optimization in separate commits. Production-copy migration verification confirmed duplicate-pick cleanup, repaired 132 invalid pick contexts, and one valid group assignment per active membership. Backend tests and frontend lint/production builds pass.

commit.message: Skip already scored picks in results sync

name: Use DraftKings when Bet365 has no game line
description: Keep Bet365 as the preferred Covers sportsbook for point spreads, but use DraftKings when Bet365 has no valid spread for a game. Add unit coverage proving the preference and fallback behavior, then commit and verify independently.
result: Kept Bet365 as the preferred Covers line source and added DraftKings as the fallback when Bet365 has no valid, dated non-zero spread. Added Go unit tests confirming Bet365 priority and DraftKings fallback. Verified go test ./... and git diff --check.

commit.message: Fall back to DraftKings game spreads

name: Add commissioner game-inclusion overrides
description: After picks UI approval, expose commissioner controls to include/exclude league games per week, preserving manual override semantics. Add protected backend API and validate authorization and state changes.
result: Added a commissioner-only League game availability settings panel with include/exclude controls, matchup search, result count, manual-override explanation, and toast feedback. Added protected backend override endpoint that validates commissioner, league, week, and game context and upserts a manual league-game assignment. User manually verified game override behavior; frontend TypeScript and backend Go tests passed.

name: Enforce one pick per league game context
description: Prevent duplicate submissions for a game within the same league, season/year, and week at server/database levels. Validate existing production duplicates and commit independently.
result: Added an immediate server-side duplicate check for an existing group pick on the same league_game, plus a partial unique database index on (league_game, league_team) to stop concurrent/replayed requests. The migration removes the one confirmed duplicate in the production copy while retaining the first submission. Verified npm run lint, npm run build, git diff --check, and ran migration successfully against a disposable production-data.db copy: duplicate groups reduced from 1 to 0 and the unique index was created.

commit.message: Prevent duplicate picks for league games

name: Calculate standings percentages from scored games
description: Use finalized/scored picks as the denominator for win percentage while retaining total submitted-pick count. Commit and verify independently.
result: Changed standings win-percentage denominator from every submitted pick to only scored outcomes (wins, losses, and pushes), so future/unscored picks no longer lower a group’s percentage. Verified npm run lint and npm run build.

commit.message: Base win percentage on completed games

name: Add invitation lifecycle management
description: Add a commissioner-facing invitation list for each eligible league with state, expiration, usage details, copy-again action, and revoke support. Add any necessary protected backend endpoint/action. Verify invitation creation, display, and revoke behavior; then stop for user testing before beginning subsequent work.
result: Implemented commissioner invitation history with usage, expiration, state badges, safe revoke confirmation, and refresh feedback. Added protected revoke endpoint with commissioner authorization. Added created_at and updated_at migrations for chronological history. Signup now uses PocketBase's username auto-generation so normal names with spaces are accepted, and new invitees receive a default display name. Verified revoke and signup flows manually with the user; frontend TypeScript validation and backend go test passed.

name: Surface completed game results in weekly picks
description: Show final score and color every revealed pick by WIN, LOST, or PUSH when scoring is complete. Commit and verify independently.
result: Weekly cards now display final score when a game is FINAL, FINAL OT, or COMPLETE, and use green WIN, red LOST, and yellow PUSH result treatments after scoring. Pending/in-progress picks retain their existing team-selection treatment.

name: Improve completed-game results and pick visibility
description: Fix standings win percentage so it is based on completed/scored games rather than all submitted picks. On Weekly picks, show WIN in green, LOST in red, and PUSH in yellow after a game is complete. Hide zero-limit pick-progress cards. Show game scores in Weekly and user dashboard views when available. Deliver each requested improvement in its own commit and preserve unrelated workspace changes.
result: Completed all four requested results/visibility improvements in separate commits. Verified the combined frontend changes with npm run lint, npm run build, and git diff --check. Existing unrelated create-invite change remains unstaged.

commit.message: Show completed game scores on dashboard

name: Refresh game drill-down presentation
description: Make game detail/more-information UI visually and interactionally consistent with existing shadcn components. Commit independently.
result: Rebuilt the game pick detail screen with the project’s shadcn Card hierarchy, consistent header/status treatment, responsive information tiles, result styling, and a standard ghost back button. It clearly distinguishes the immutable submitted spread from game details. Consulted current shadcn/ui composition guidance. Verified npm run lint, npm run build, and git diff --check.

name: Finish league experience and operations UI
description: Implement and validate the remaining Pickems product improvements in this agreed order: (1) invitation list, revoke, and usage management; (2) picks-page usability; (3) commissioner game-inclusion overrides; (4) platform-admin scheduler health dashboard; (5) results/standings visual upgrade. Work one item at a time, stop after each item for user testing before moving forward. Preserve unrelated existing work and validate each completed feature.
result: Completed the agreed five-part product polish initiative in order: invitation lifecycle management, picks usability and search, commissioner game overrides, scheduler health, and responsive standings. Each item was manually verified by the user before continuing. Commits: bd1ddd0, 7ba5052, ad71eba, 5f199d3, dda28cc, and 2a9d58c.

name: Upgrade results and standings UI
description: After scheduler dashboard approval, improve standings/results hierarchy and visual insight while retaining responsive table access. Verify final build and user flows.
result: Reworked standings with podium cards, personal-rank context, weekly movement and weekly-leader summaries, a simplified desktop table, and mobile-first expandable standings cards. Removed the cluttered multi-team chart after user feedback. User manually verified desktop and mobile results views; frontend TypeScript validation passed.

name: Improve picks-page usability
description: After invitation management is approved, improve pick discovery and status clarity with appropriate filters, summaries, locked/open states, and empty/loading feedback. Verify responsive behavior and stop for user testing.
result: Added an at-a-glance open/locked week state, per-sport/per-type pick progress cards, tab game counts, responsive game grids, empty states, and disabled game-card controls during locked weeks. User manually verified the picks UI; frontend TypeScript validation passed.

commit.message: Improve picks page clarity and locked states

name: Add scheduler health dashboard
description: After game overrides approval, add platform-admin UI for scheduler run health, status, timestamps, errors, and tracked record counts. Update protected health response as needed and validate access control.
result: Added a platform-admin scheduler health dashboard to league requests, showing latest job state, timestamps, throughput counts, failed-record count, errors, and empty/error states. Extended the protected scheduler health endpoint with stored run counts. User manually verified the dashboard; frontend TypeScript and backend Go tests passed.

name: Clarify weekly closing lines and member spreads
description: Confirm whether weekly over/under represents closing line and present closing over/under and each person pick spread cleanly. Commit independently.
result: Clarified the Weekly page’s two different line values: the game header now explicitly labels the latest synced Bet365 spread, while every member row labels its immutable submission snapshot as Pick line. Improved line hierarchy and replaced the misleading checkmark with a target icon. Confirmed the application does not currently store an over/under total or a separately certified closing line; it stores point spreads only. Verified npm run lint, npm run build, and git diff --check.

commit.message: Clarify weekly game and pick lines

name: Correct league-group membership and settings behavior
description: Inspect membership data, authorization, and settings update paths so every person has the intended league_group and updates behave predictably. Commit and verify independently.
result: Scoped the commissioner settings assignment query to the active league, made group moves transactional, rejected inactive targets, and added a unique membership index so a person cannot be assigned to multiple groups. All creation flows already assign a group. Verified go test ./..., npm run lint, npm run build, git diff --check, and migrated a disposable production-data.db copy: 0 active members lacked or had multiple assignments and the uniqueness index was present.

name: Preserve pick associations when leagues are renamed
description: Identify name-based associations and replace them with stable IDs so renaming a league cannot disconnect or misattribute picks. Commit and verify independently.
result: Confirmed active code stores pick, group, league-game, week, and league references as stable record IDs rather than mutable names. Added a production-safe repair migration for 18 historical league-game records whose week relation did not match their picks; the production copy contained 132 affected picks. Verified on a disposable production-data.db copy after all migrations: invalid game/week/league pick contexts reduced from 132 to 0; all active members still had exactly one group.

name: Show scores on the dashboard
description: Show final/current game score in dashboard pick tables where a score is available. Commit and verify independently.
result: Added Score columns to desktop and mobile dashboard pick tables. Final, overtime-final, and COMPLETE games show away–home scores; uncompleted games show an em dash.

commit.message: Show completed game scores on dashboard

name: Avoid redundant completed-pick scoring writes
description: After completed picks have been scored, avoid saving them on every one-minute scheduler run. This reduces database writes and scheduler load while preserving scoring of pending completed picks. Commit and verify independently.
result: Updated the once-per-minute results job to skip picks that already have a result, preventing repeated writes for completed games while allowing newly completed pending picks to score. Verified go test ./... and git diff --check.

commit.message: Skip already scored picks in results sync

name: Persist selected league
description: Remember a user selected league across relevant navigation and reloads while remaining valid for their memberships. Commit independently.
result: Persisted a league selected from the league switcher in a one-year same-site cookie. Legacy/non-slug routes now resolve that selected active league, while a stale or unauthorized cookie safely falls back to another active membership. Explicit league URLs retain priority. Verified npm run lint, npm run build, and git diff --check.

name: Fix completed game synchronization and scoring
description: Trace scheduler/provider synchronization and scoring flow against production records. Ensure final scores update league games and picks are scored reliably. Commit and verify independently.
result: Added one shared completed-game predicate that recognizes Covers' current COMPLETE status alongside historical FINAL and FINAL OT values. Game import winner calculation and scheduled pick scoring now use it, so the 6 unscored production picks tied to COMPLETE games will be scored by the next results job. Verified with go test ./... (pass) and git diff --check.

commit.message: Fix scoring for completed provider games
